chunks: Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah and al-Fudayl said: We said to him,

Is prayer in congregation obligatory? He said, 'The prayers are obligatory, but the gathering [congregation] is not obligatory in all prayers; rather, it is a sunnah. Whoever leaves it out of preference for it and for the congregation of the believers without an excuse, has no prayer [for him].'
ai.seo_question: Is praying in congregation obligatory in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from the Tahdhib al-Ahkam distinguishes between the individual obligation of prayer and the recommended status of congregational prayer, a nuance central to Shia fiqh regarding the validity of solitary worship. The Imam specifies that neglecting congregation without a valid excuse renders the prayer 'lacking' (or invalid depending on interpretation), emphasizing the communal bond of the believers. This highlights the theological weight of 'jama'ah' not just as a ritual format but as a marker of communal fidelity.
